full_judgment: We are in respectful agreement with these observations of the Indian Supreme Court and the function of the Advisory Board under the Special Powers Act is similar to the Preventive Detention Act, 1950 (India). Therefore, the contention of the Deputy Attorney-General does not appear to have any force.
